model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between “Block Index” and “Sensitivity” for two data series, “4-Fbit” and “2-Fbit”. The horizontal axis is labeled “Block Index” and contains numerical categories ranging from 0 to 27, listed in ascending order. The vertical axis is labeled “Sensitivity” and uses a logarithmic scale, with tick marks at 10⁻⁵, 10⁻⁴, and 10⁻³, representing the scale’s range. Each Block Index has two bars: a blue bar representing “4-Fbit” and a green bar representing “2-Fbit”. For Block Index 0, the “4-Fbit” bar reaches approximately 2.5 x 10⁻³, while the “2-Fbit” bar reaches approximately 3.5 x 10⁻⁴.  At Block Index 27, the “4-Fbit” bar reaches approximately 9 x 10⁻³, and the “2-Fbit” bar reaches approximately 5 x 10⁻⁴.  Generally, the “4-Fbit” bars are taller than corresponding “2-Fbit” bars, and the height of the “4-Fbit” bars tends to increase as Block Index increases from 0 to 27; the “2-Fbit” bars exhibit a more moderate and less consistently increasing trend. No bars appear to be visually emphasized.
